má sobe direto; mǎ desce e volta a subir.en: má rises steadily; mǎ falls and rises again.

O 1º tom fica alto e reto; o 4º cai firm.en: The 1st tone stays high and level; the 4th falls firmly. The 2nd rises; the 3rd falls and rises again. Comparing pairs trains your ear faster.

O 2º tom sobe direto. O 3º tom desce e s.en: The 2nd tone rises steadily. The 3rd tone falls and rises, like a dip.

O 4º tom cai rápido e firme, como um com.en: The 4th tone falls quickly and firmly, like a short command.
